summary: UHF RFID apparel hang tags embed a UHF inlay into a standard cardboard or synthetic hang tag, enabling item-level inventory accuracy from the factory floor to the retail shelf. Over 30 billion RFID tags ship annually for apparel — source tagging at manufacture is now the industry standard for major retailers.
